policy: All three queued cases now have independent historical hypothesis provenance and quantitative outcome evidence. Queue membership still does not imply scored-gold eligibility; confidence provenance and supported outcome-class mapping remain mandatory.

candidates.evidence_summary: S&P Global supplied a pre-outcome shipping-market hypothesis during the blockage; SCA supplied 81-vessel/4.8-million-net-ton clearing-day metrics; UNCTAD later documented a renewed container spot-rate surge.
candidates.next_gate: Find a contemporaneous source that expressed a bounded probability/confidence for the predicted congestion/freight outcome, or leave the case unscored. Separately define and validate an outcome-class mapping rule without hindsight.

candidates.evidence_summary: IMF supplied an independent pre-outcome mechanism hypothesis about easing Black Sea logistics constraints; FAO supplied July price changes; UN JCC supplied cumulative tonnage and a multi-month export series.
candidates.next_gate: Find historically grounded confidence/probability evidence for the mechanism and define a causal-safe outcome mapping that does not attribute all observed price movement to the Initiative.

candidates.evidence_summary: Bundesnetzagentur supplied a pre-operation high-utilization/security-of-supply hypothesis; Uniper supplied first-cargo volumes and first-year results of 42 carriers, about 4 bcm gas fed to the grid and about 6% of 2023 German gas consumption.
candidates.next_gate: Find historical confidence/probability evidence for expected utilization or supply contribution and define a thresholded outcome mapping against the sourced nameplate/throughput evidence.
